compositeformat-reuse.title: Reuse parsed composite formats with CompositeFormat
compositeformat-reuse.short: Parse a repeatedly used format string once
compositeformat-reuse.summary: CompositeFormat represents a parsed composite format string that can be reused by APIs such as string.Format.
compositeformat-reuse.why: Hot paths that repeatedly apply the same complex format can avoid parsing the format structure on every call.
compositeformat-reuse.tips: For one-off formatting, interpolation or ordinary string.Format is simpler. Consider CompositeFormat when the same format is retained and reused many times.

periodictimer-await-ticks.title: Await periodic work with PeriodicTimer
periodictimer-await-ticks.short: Run cancelable periodic work in a sequential async loop
periodictimer-await-ticks.summary: PeriodicTimer exposes each tick through WaitForNextTickAsync for natural async control flow.
periodictimer-await-ticks.why: Compared with callback timers, ordering, exceptions, and cancellation remain in the ordinary async method flow.
periodictimer-await-ticks.tips: Do not issue multiple concurrent WaitForNextTickAsync calls on the same timer.

iasyncenumerable-streaming.title: Stream asynchronous results with IAsyncEnumerable
iasyncenumerable-streaming.short: Process values as they arrive instead of buffering them all
iasyncenumerable-streaming.summary: IAsyncEnumerable<T> lets await foreach consume elements asynchronously one at a time.
iasyncenumerable-streaming.why: Large or delayed result sets can be processed before every item has been accumulated into a List.
iasyncenumerable-streaming.tips: Propagate cancellation and make the lifetime of resources used by the enumeration explicit.

gc-no-gc-region.title: Suppress GC in a latency-critical region with GC.TryStartNoGCRegion
gc-no-gc-region.short: Enter a no-GC region only when the requested memory budget can be reserved
gc-no-gc-region.summary: GC.TryStartNoGCRegion is an advanced API for avoiding garbage collections during a bounded operation when its memory requirement can be satisfied.
gc-no-gc-region.why: Workloads with strict short-term latency requirements can sometimes avoid GC pauses inside a measured critical section.
gc-no-gc-region.tips: This is not a general performance switch. Measure allocations, call EndNoGCRegion only after a successful start, and prefer ordinary low-allocation design first.

conditionalweaktable-metadata.title: Attach metadata without extending lifetime using ConditionalWeakTable
conditionalweaktable-metadata.short: Associate auxiliary data with objects through weak keys
conditionalweaktable-metadata.summary: ConditionalWeakTable<TKey,TValue> associates values with keys without keeping those keys alive solely because of the table.
conditionalweaktable-metadata.why: It is useful for attaching information to objects you cannot modify without turning the metadata store into an ownership root.
conditionalweaktable-metadata.tips: It is not a general Dictionary replacement; use another structure for ordinary lookup, enumeration, or cache policies.

jsonnode-dom-edit.title: Edit JSON as a mutable DOM with JsonNode
jsonnode-dom-edit.short: Parse, change selected values, and serialize again
jsonnode-dom-edit.summary: JsonNode provides a mutable JSON DOM whose properties and array elements can be edited directly.
jsonnode-dom-edit.why: It is convenient when only part of a document must change without defining a complete object model.
jsonnode-dom-edit.tips: For very large documents, consider streaming APIs such as Utf8JsonReader instead of materializing the entire DOM.

utf8jsonwriter-streaming.title: Write JSON incrementally with Utf8JsonWriter
utf8jsonwriter-streaming.short: Emit UTF-8 JSON without building a complete object graph
utf8jsonwriter-streaming.summary: Utf8JsonWriter is a low-level API that writes JSON tokens in sequence.
utf8jsonwriter-streaming.why: Large outputs and custom formats can be written with precise control and fewer intermediate objects.
utf8jsonwriter-streaming.tips: Balance every object and array start with an end token and flush at appropriate boundaries.

semaphoreslim-async-throttle.title: Throttle asynchronous concurrency with SemaphoreSlim
semaphoreslim-async-throttle.short: Limit entry with WaitAsync and Release
semaphoreslim-async-throttle.summary: SemaphoreSlim allows only a fixed number of operations through and supports asynchronous waiting with WaitAsync.
semaphoreslim-async-throttle.why: It prevents an unbounded number of requests from overwhelming an external API or scarce resource.
semaphoreslim-async-throttle.tips: Release in finally after a successful acquisition; do not release when acquisition itself failed or was canceled.

pipereader-sequences.title: Read segmented byte streams efficiently with PipeReader
pipereader-sequences.short: Process ReadOnlySequence data while avoiding unnecessary copies
pipereader-sequences.summary: PipeReader manages buffering and exposes read data as ReadOnlySequence<byte>.
pipereader-sequences.why: Network and protocol parsers can handle data arriving in segments without first concatenating it into one array.
pipereader-sequences.tips: Report consumed and examined positions correctly with AdvanceTo or buffers may be retained or read repeatedly.

bitoperations-popcount.title: Count set bits with BitOperations.PopCount
bitoperations-popcount.short: Get the number of one bits in an integer
bitoperations-popcount.summary: BitOperations.PopCount counts the one bits in an integer's binary representation.
bitoperations-popcount.why: Bit sets and flag counts can be expressed directly instead of with a hand-written bit loop.
bitoperations-popcount.tips: For signed values, make the intended bit width explicit and convert to the corresponding unsigned type.
